raw_text: Satellite imagery confirms China has built a new bridge structure at Finger 8 on Pangong Tso. This is a significant development as it gives the PLA improved logistics capability on the northern bank. The bridge appears to be a standard military pontoon type that can support armoured vehicles. India will need to respond with proportional infrastructure development in the Finger 4 area to maintain the balance. The 2020 disengagement agreement seems to be under increasing strain.
